title: Freestanding Toilet Tissue Stand 27-Inch Solid Brass Euro Hook | Carolina Collection | Allied Brass
body_html:
Add flexible toilet paper storage to your bathroom without drilling by choosing this freestanding toilet tissue stand with a European style hook and a stable, heavy base.

  • Freestanding placement: no wall mounting required—ideal when wall space is limited
  • Easy roll changes: European style hook makes swapping rolls quick
  • Solid brass construction: built for enduring strength
  • Stable base: heavy base helps prevent tipping
  • Coordinated look: designed to pair with matching pieces in the Carolina collection

Specs

  • Category: Freestanding Toilet Tissue Stands
  • Collection: Carolina
  • Style: Traditional (with a transitional, versatile look)
  • Mounting type: Freestanding
  • Material: Brass
  • Dimensions: 27 in H x 8 in L x 6 in W
  • Weight: 5.6 lb
  • Assembly required: Yes
  • Included items: Toilet tissue stand
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

Multiple designer finish options are available to help coordinate with your transitional bathroom hardware and other versatile bath accessories.

_previous.description: Add the finishing touch to your bathroom with this elegant free standing European style toilet tissue stand. When wall space is at a premium this product works great to provide the essential part of your project. European style hook makes changing the roll quick and easy, so there should be no more arguments about changing the roll. Made of the finest solid brass materials with a sturdy base that will keep the stand secure from tipping.
